lore_anchors.definition: A folk martial technique involving chanting and ritual to summon a deity's power for temporary invulnerability in combat.
Sacred written charms in Daoist tradition, used to command spirits, heal, or attack. Each stroke must be precise to harness its intended supernatural power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Zhuge spine sword made of?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is refined from the spine of Zhuge Yuan, a Heart-Entwined being, giving it the power to impose a false history onto reality.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Li Huowang disguise the spine sword?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he stole it from the Supervisory Heavenly Office, and carrying it openly would mark him for immediate pursuit and execution.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can Bai Lingmiao read if she is blind?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She can feel the texture of the ink on the paper, sensing where the characters are written, allowing her to read by touch.
